fields.label: Month No.
fields.description: Months after the unit's plan start date. Leave blank if using a Fixed Due Date instead.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: e.g. 'Society Fee', 'Water Charge'. Shown on the invoice line. Leave blank to default to 'Maintenance charge - <unit> - <period>'.

fields.label: Fixed Due Date
fields.description: Optional -- bill on this exact calendar date instead of Month No.

fields.label: Item (override)
fields.description: Optional -- use a different Item than Property Core Settings' default Maintenance Item Code for this charge (e.g. a separate Item for Water Charge).
